title: Croatian Dumplings with Old Fashioned Dough
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring homemade dumplings and rich, old-fashioned dough.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and salt. Mix well.
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a large pot of salted water and bring it to a boil.
Punch down the dough and divide it into small pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of cottage cheese, some chopped scallions, and a sprinkle of black pepper in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Carefully place the dumplings into the boiling water and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot with a dollop of sour cream.
